sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE VIVEK RUSIA  ON THE 9 th OF AUGUST, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 33341 of 2024  HARIRAM JATAV  Versus
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

Appearance:
 Shri Sushil Goswami - Advocate for the applicant.
 Smt. Ankita Mathur - Public Prosecutor for respondent/St  ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime No. 198 of 2024 registered at Police Station Mau, District Bhind (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 304B, 498A, 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
As per prosecution story, F.I.R. No.198/2024 was lodged by the complainant Diwan Singh Gurjar that the marriage of deceased Chameli was solemnized with Sumit Jatav on 09.05.2022.

After marriage, the family members of in-laws of deceased started the demand of dowry of Rs.50,000/-
but he could not fulfill.
FIR was lodged against them under Sections 304-B, 498A, 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibiton Act.
The deceased was died on 13.06.2024.
As per opinion of Doctor, he conducted the post-mortem of the deceased and she died due to coronary occlusion - a disease of heart but did not give opinion that this death is a homicidal death.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that she was pregnant of 8 months.
No injuries were found on the body of the deceased.
It was a natural 2 MCRC-33341-2024 death.
The family members have been falsely implicated in this case.
Doctor has given opinion that she died because of cardiac arrest.
Further submission is that there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
The applicant shall abide by the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court, if he is granted anticipatory bail.
On the other hand, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and in the event of arrest, the applicant be released on anticipatory bail on executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer /Investigating Authority.

The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and shall cooperate in the investigation, otherwise this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VIVEK RUSIA) JUDGE AK/-
